def factor_overnight_reversal_volume_intensity(df):
    """Overnight gap reversal scaled by volume intensity."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    base_signal = -overnight_ret
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    vol_intensity = 1.0 + np.clip(vol_ratio - 1.0, 0.0, 0.5)
    signal = base_signal * vol_intensity
    df_copy["factor_overnight_reversal_volume_intensity"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_reversal_volume_intensity"]
description: Overnight gap reversal. The core idea is that large overnight moves tend to reverse, creating a signal proportional to the negative overnight return. Volume intensity from classify_volume_regime (vol_ratio) captures whether current volume is above normal; high volume strengthens the reversal signal, reflecting greater positioning pressure. The child simplifies the parent by removing the disagreement amplification and replacing the complex ATR-based volatility regime with a lightweight volume intensity gate, preserving the core overnight reversal mechanism while easing the parameter burden. This targets improved robustness and IC/ICIR stability while maintaining the economic intuition.
